# Flag: a white pole 1.35 m tall standing in the cup, a red knob on top and a yellow pennant
# 0.6 m long (tapering to a point) near the top, pointing right. Origin at the pole's foot.
new
material new Pole --base-color 0.9804 1.0000 0.9882 --no-slot
material new Knob --base-color 0.8588 0.2941 0.2392 --no-slot
material new Pennant --base-color 1.0000 0.9216 0.2000 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Pole --vertices 6 --radius 0.04 --depth 1.35 --location 0 0 0.675
material assign Pole
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --name Knob --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.07 --location 0 0 1.39
material assign Knob
add mesh cube --name Pennant --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.62 0.05 0.42
apply --scale
translate 0.33 0 1.1
apply --location
mode edit
select vert where "pos.x > 0.6"
scale 1 1 0.12
mode object
material assign Pennant
select all
shade flat
export flag.glb
